Application Description:
This application is developed to estimate monthly electricity bills based on month, electricity unit used and rebate percentage.

How to Use:
1. Select the month.
2. Enter electricity unit used from 1 to 1000 kWh.
3. Enter rebate percentage from 0% to 5%.
4. Tap Calculate and Save.
5. The total charges and final cost will be shown on the same page.
6. Tap View Saved Bills to see saved records.
7. Tap any record to view detail, update or delete it.
